what_happened: On a wet multi-lane freeway with the command switching to RIGHT, the ego slowed from 6.7 to 4.4 m/s and drifted left toward the lane line instead of holding its lane or moving right. Its front hit actor 41, which was passing in the left lane, about 1.7 m left of the recorded human path.

On a straight highway with a STRAIGHT command, the ego braked hard for no clear reason (20.6 to 8.6 m/s, with the lead pulling away) and turned left toward the next lane. Its front-left corner hit actor 1, which was just ahead in that left lane. The ego was also rear-ended at some point, likely because of the sudden braking.

On a multi-lane highway, the ego's plan (orange path) kept angling left toward the next lane while it slowed from about 7.9 to 4.6 m/s. Actor 41 was coming up alongside in that left lane, and the ego's front-left corner swiped it at 7.2 s, about 1.3 m off the recorded human path; the lead truck stayed 17–22 m ahead the whole time and was not involved.

On a multi-lane highway with the command STRAIGHT (RIGHT in the last frame), the policy's planned path bent left, away from the recorded path, which stays in the lane. The ego slowed from 7.9 to 4.6 m/s while it angled into the lane to its left. At 7.2 s its front corner hit vehicle 41, which was travelling alongside in that lane.

After handoff on a straight highway, the ego braked hard (20.6 to 8.3 m/s) with no close lead, the gap ahead having opened to about 50 m. Actor 1 in the left adjacent lane drew alongside and moved ahead. The ego's path then bent left, about 1.1 m off the recorded trajectory, and its front-left corner clipped actor 1.

After handoff, the ego braked hard for no clear reason, from about 20 to 8 m/s, even though the lead car was pulling away. Its planned path also bent left toward the adjacent lane. Actor 1, which had been beside the ego on the left, moved ahead as the ego slowed, and the ego's front-left corner hit actor 1's rear-right corner. Being rear-ended afterwards is a result of the sudden braking.

On a multi-lane highway, the policy's planned path (orange) bent left toward the next lane, while the recorded human path stayed straight and later curved right, with the command switching to RIGHT. The ego slowed from 6.7 to 5.0 m/s and drifted left into actor 41, which was driving alongside in the left lane, so the ego's front-left hit it at 7.2 s, about 1.4 m off the recorded path.

While slowing behind the truck on a multi-lane highway, the ego drifted left into the next lane, against its recorded path and the later RIGHT command. Its front-left hit car 41, which was driving alongside in that lane.
